name: Moped, up to 2 hp and 30 mph
description: The moped the classifications naming this group share: a motor of no more than 2 brake horsepower (1,500 W) that can't propel it faster than 30 mph. A vehicle carries this group's id in place of each classification in it, and each of those holds its own jurisdiction's license, registration, insurance, helmet and riding rules.

restrictions.rule: Its motor produces no more than 2 brake horsepower (1,500 W)
restrictions.citation: Revised Code of Washington §46.04.304; Utah Code §41-6a-102; West Virginia Code §17C-1-5a

restrictions.rule: The motor can't propel it faster than 30 mph
restrictions.citation: Revised Code of Washington §46.04.304; Utah Code §41-6a-102; West Virginia Code §17C-1-5a

restrictions.rule: Past its jurisdiction's e-bike limits; one within them is an electric bicycle instead
